label: Local Time
tagline: Viewers ask what time it is for you with !time.
description: Viewers type !time and the bot answers with your current local time. They can also ask about another place: !time Tokyo, !time EST, !time UTC+2. Pick your timezone below. The page suggests the one your browser reports, computed on your device only (nothing is read or stored until you save it). Choose a 12- or 24-hour clock and customize both replies.

timezone.label: Timezone
timezone.help: IANA timezone name used to render {time} and {date}. The suggestion comes from your browser and is never stored until you save it.

time.defaultMessage: It is currently {time} for the streamer.
